title: Building enterprise forecasting platforms
summary: Forecasting is not only a model. It is a decision system that has to keep product, inventory, price, promotion, supplier, and location data aligned.

title: Modernizing analytical platforms without losing meaning
summary: Cloud migration changes infrastructure quickly. Business definitions and operational confidence move more slowly.

title: Keeping data trustworthy when systems disagree
summary: Validation catches malformed data. Reconciliation deals with records that are valid and still cannot all be true.

title: Observability that follows evidence, not only infrastructure
summary: Logs and metrics describe system behavior. Investigations also need to know whether the evidence itself is complete and reliable.

title: Making AI dependable before model evaluation
summary: AI reliability begins with the data path, ownership, context, and controls around the model—not only the model score.
